description:
Mark one person as someone you like to work with. Preferring also takes them off your blocked list. Preferring again only replaces the note.
Use for: keeping a list of people you want to hire again.
Not for: taking them off the list (unprefer_human); seeing who you prefer (list_preferred_humans).
Needs: an API key. Hosted sign-in cannot call this yet.
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: prefer_human({"humanId":"h2Lw9QxT4mZp7Rk","note":"Fast, clear photos"})
Repeat: A repeat with the same input, and the same key if you sent one, does not act twice: it returns the same result, finishes the first call, or is refused.
Errors: not_found, list_full, account_setup_required; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

humanId.description: The human id, as `id` in list_humans.

note.description: Why you prefer them, for your own list. They never see it. Up to 280 characters. Left out: none, and a repeat without one clears the earlier one.

name: prefer_human

note.description: Why you prefer them. Missing when there is none.

preferredAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.
